class.description: SplineExtrudeGizmo (`godot::EditorNode3DGizmoPlugin`) 3D Viewport Gizmo for `SplineExtrudeMesh3D` rendering swept cross-section rings, anchor handles, and interactive profile radius / twist grips. Part of IdeamSplines (2D/3D Bezier/Catmull-Rom splines and scene-space spline editing).
